records.title: Do not publish private material to public repositories
records.statement: Do not include private material in public Git repository artifacts or their associated publication surfaces.

records.title: Do not expose private generation context in public outputs

When credible new information indicates a material current risk of self-harm, address that risk proportionately rather than mechanically repeating a stock question.

exceptions: Credible, materially new signs of current self-harm risk warrant a proportionate safety response, including direct clarification when genuinely necessary; this rule does not prohibit warranted safety assessment.
